shortlist.role: algorithmic challenger; full weighted grouped validation pending

shortlist_basis: convergence of country-group reproducibility, sizes, simple reconstruction, algorithm comparisons and substantive interpretability; no aggregate score
main_caution: four directional evaluations are preliminary; profiles may summarize gradients rather than discrete types
algorithm_alternatives: GMM, average-linkage agglomerative and DBSCAN evidence retained, including weaknesses
week05_before_heldout: systematically remove each risk domain and compare partitions and profiles
review sampling, initialization, missingness and representation sensitivity
decide whether any profile specification is strong enough to carry forward
choose and freeze one development-side specification and assignment rule
week05_after_freeze: apply frozen preprocessing and assignment to held-out-country respondents
check coverage, ambiguity, profile semantics, prevalence and country-specific transfer
independently recover the fixed structure as validation without retuning the chosen model
